description: Processed grid-level dataset and reproducibility code for sector congestion prediction in air traffic management is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors xiaoyu yan. This dataset and code package supports the manuscript “Prediction Framework for Sector Congestion in Air Traffic Management”. It contains de-identified processed grid-level data, K-means++ labeling code, model training code, trained model files, evaluation materials, and an interface replay case for sector congestion prediction. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 270624518 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
